dialogue.origin: こんにちわ
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.content: Hello. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 自分の事で・・
dialogue.content: It's about myself...

dialogue.origin: ご自分のどのようなことでしょうか
dialogue.content: What specifically about yourself?

dialogue.origin: 自分の性格に嫌気がしています
dialogue.content: I'm fed up with my personality.

dialogue.origin: 人の幸せを素直に喜べなくて
dialogue.content: I can't genuinely be happy for other people's happiness.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね…それは、少しつらいですね…
dialogue.content: I see... That must be a bit painful...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どのようなときに、そのように感じられたのですか？
dialogue.content: In what situations do you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 友達が結婚したり、
dialogue.content: When my friends get married,

dialogue.origin: 出産したり
dialogue.content: or have children.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お祝い事等
dialogue.content: At celebrations and such.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 素直に喜べず、自分が嫌いで
dialogue.content: I can't be genuinely happy for them, and I hate myself for it.

dialogue.origin: 孤独を感じます
dialogue.content: I feel lonely.

dialogue.origin: 自分がお嫌いになるのは、しんどいですね…
dialogue.content: It must be tough to dislike yourself...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 幸せな気持ちに共感できないのは、寂しい気持ちになりますね…いつごろから、そのように感じられるようになったのですか？
dialogue.content: Not being able to empathize with their happy feelings must make you feel lonely... When did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.origin: 子供の頃も友達の幸せそうな家庭環境にねたんだり、友達が結婚するようになっても更に
dialogue.content: Even as a child, I would envy my friends' seemingly happy family environments, and it got even worse when my friends started getting married.

dialogue.origin: 寂しいというよりは羨ましいが強くて
dialogue.content: It's more envy than loneliness.

dialogue.origin: はい。そうなのですね…
dialogue.content: I see. So that's how it is...

dialogue.origin: 心からお祝いしていない自分がいて
dialogue.content: There's a part of me that isn't celebrating from the heart.

dialogue.origin: 一人ぼっちな気がしてます
dialogue.content: and I feel all alone.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね…ご友人が喜ばれるのを一緒に喜べない寂しさ、孤独を感じられているのですね…
dialogue.content: I see... You're feeling the sadness and loneliness of not being able to share in your friends' joy...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 自分は存在してはいけない人間なんじゃないかとか・・
dialogue.content: I sometimes think that maybe I shouldn't even exist...

dialogue.origin: そのように感じていたら、人とコミュニケーションとるのが、どんどん苦しくなってきてしましますね…
dialogue.content: Feeling that way, communicating with people must become increasingly difficult...

dialogue.origin: そんなふうにお感じなんですね…
dialogue.content: So that's how you're feeling...

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 人の不幸話にホッとする自分が居て
dialogue.content: There's a part of me that feels relieved when I hear about other people's misfortunes.

dialogue.origin: はい、、、。どんどん、自分が嫌になってしまいますね。。。子供のころからうらやましいというお気持ちが強かったとのことですが、どのようなご家庭だったのか、お話していただけますか？
dialogue.content: I see... That must make you dislike yourself more and more... You mentioned that you've had strong feelings of envy since you were a child. Could you tell me about what your family was like, if you're comfortable?

dialogue.origin: 話せる範囲で構いませんので
dialogue.content: You only have to share what you're comfortable with.

dialogue.origin: もし、よろしければ…
dialogue.content: If you'd like...

dialogue.origin: 父は厳しく、母はずっと泣いていた。女らしくしろ！母の様にはなるなと。いつも喧嘩ばかり
dialogue.content: My father was strict, and my mother was always crying. He would tell me, "Be more ladylike! Don't become like your mother." They were always fighting.

dialogue.origin: 父が嫌いでした
dialogue.content: I hated my father.

dialogue.origin: そんなご家庭だったのですね…　息苦しくなってしまいそうです…
dialogue.content: So that's what your family was like... It sounds suffocating...

dialogue.origin: グレてしまって迷惑かけたけど
dialogue.content: I rebelled and caused a lot of trouble, though.

dialogue.origin: 生んでくれたことを責めたこともある
dialogue.content: I've even blamed them for giving birth to me.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね…　ご家族に反発しないとご自分を保っていられないような、環境だったのですね…
dialogue.content: I see... It sounds like it was an environment where you couldn't maintain your sense of self without rebelling against your family...

dialogue.origin: 妹は大人しく直ぐ泣くからかわいがられていた
dialogue.content: My younger sister was quiet and would cry easily, so she was doted on.

dialogue.origin: おねえちゃんみたいになるなといわれていた
dialogue.content: I was told, "Don't be like your older sister."

dialogue.origin: そうなのですか！　それは、とっても精神的にきつい状況ですね…
dialogue.content: Is that so! That must have been an incredibly mentally taxing situation...

dialogue.origin: その時から、孤独だったのではないでしょうか…
dialogue.content: Perhaps you've felt lonely since then...

dialogue.origin: 父の言葉は慣れっこでした。父とは相性が悪かったです
dialogue.content: I got used to my father's words. We just didn't get along.

dialogue.origin: 大げんかして家を出て警察にもお世話になって
dialogue.content: We had a huge fight, I left home, and the police even got involved.

dialogue.origin: 麻痺させてきたのですね…　親との相性が悪いと家にいても、居場所がないように感じますね…
dialogue.content: You must have numbed yourself to it... When you don't get along with your parents, it can feel like you have no place to belong, even at home...

dialogue.origin: 教生施設みたいな所に入って
dialogue.content: I ended up in a place like a juvenile training school.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…　なかなか、あなたの心の声をキャッチしてくれなかったのですね…
dialogue.content: I see... It sounds like they didn't really pick up on your inner voice...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですかね・・
dialogue.content: I wonder if that's the case...

dialogue.origin: ご両親は、自分のことばかりで、あなたが本当にどう感じているか、どう思っているか、感じとる、想像する余裕のある人たちではなかった
dialogue.content: Your parents were so wrapped up in their own issues that they didn't have the capacity to sense or imagine how you were truly feeling or what you were thinking.

dialogue.origin: 父と離れて、父からの手紙を読んで、感謝しなくてはと、思うようになったと思っていたのに
dialogue.content: After being apart from my father and reading a letter from him, I thought I had come to feel that I should be grateful, but...

dialogue.origin: お父様から手紙をもらったのですね、すごいことですね！
dialogue.content: You received a letter from your father? That's amazing!

dialogue.origin: はい、泣きました
dialogue.content: Yes, I cried.

dialogue.origin: 嬉しくて
dialogue.content: Because I was happy.

dialogue.origin: 父の愛情は感じたのですが
dialogue.content: I did feel my father's love, but...

dialogue.origin: どのようなお言葉が心に響いたのですか。もしよろしければ、、、
dialogue.content: What words resonated with you? If you don't mind sharing...

dialogue.origin: 大変だと思うけど頑張れよと短いですが。
dialogue.content: It was short, but it said, 'I know it's tough, but hang in there.'

dialogue.origin: 愛情は、感じたのですが…の先は…
dialogue.content: You felt his love, but... what comes after the 'but'?

dialogue.origin: 今でも迷惑かけられているので、もう父に関しては諦めています
dialogue.content: He's still causing me trouble even now, so I've given up on him.

dialogue.origin: そのようなお手紙をもらってとてもうれしかったけれど、今のお父様に関してうんざりされている…
dialogue.content: So you were very happy to receive that letter, but you're fed up with your father as he is now...

dialogue.origin: 昔から母はもっと父には苦労してるので、
dialogue.content: My mother has always had an even harder time with him, so...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね…　大変なお父様だったのですね…
dialogue.content: I see... He must have been a difficult father...

dialogue.origin: 父に関しては、もう、言っても仕方ないと思っています。介護するような年になってますし。
dialogue.content: When it comes to my father, I feel there's no point in saying anything anymore. He's at an age where he needs care.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね…　ここで、少し、話を整理させていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: I understand... May I take a moment to summarize our conversation so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 人の幸せを素直に喜べない自分の性格に嫌気を感じてご相談にこられた
dialogue.content: You came to counseling because you were fed up with your inability to be genuinely happy for other people's happiness.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 子供の頃も友達の幸せそうな家庭環境をうらやましく思っていた。友達が結婚した、出産したり寂しいというよりは羨ましいが強く心からお祝いできない自分に孤独を感じてらっしゃる
dialogue.content: Since childhood, you've envied friends with seemingly happy families. When friends get married or have children, you feel a strong sense of envy rather than loneliness, and you feel isolated because you can't celebrate with them from your heart.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 女らしくしろっと育てられたが
dialogue.content: I was raised to be "ladylike," but...

dialogue.origin: お父様と相性が悪く、妹をかわいがり、比較もされ、反発していたが、離れて暮らして、お手紙をもらい、うれしいかった。が、今は、介護で面倒をかけられうんざりした気持ちがある
dialogue.content: You didn't get along with your father, he doted on your sister and compared you to her, so you rebelled. But after living apart, you received a letter from him and were happy. However, now you feel fed up because you have to deal with his care.

dialogue.origin: すいません。ネットの接続エラーで少し返事に時間がかかってしまいました
dialogue.content: I'm sorry. There was a connection error, so my reply was a little delayed.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そういった気持ちはありますが、もう、結婚もしてますから。非行に走って、今ではもう父の事はさほど思ってないです。
dialogue.content: Yes, I have those feelings, but I'm married now. I went through a rebellious phase, and now I don't think about my father that much anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…。ご自分のご家庭について考えることのほうが多いですよね。
dialogue.content: I see... You probably have more to think about regarding your own family now.

dialogue.origin: 母になれないと一人前の人間じゃないのでしょうか
dialogue.content: If I can't become a mother, does that mean I'm not a full-fledged person?

dialogue.origin: そんなふうにお感じになられるのですね…
dialogue.content: That's how it feels to you...

dialogue.origin: 出産とか喜べないんです
dialogue.content: I can't feel happy about things like childbirth.

dialogue.origin: そうおっしゃっていましたね…
dialogue.content: You did mention that...

dialogue.origin: 病気で子宮をとったのですが
dialogue.content: I had my uterus removed because of an illness,

dialogue.origin: 卵巣は置いといて欲しかった
dialogue.content: I wish they had left my ovaries.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですか…おつらいですね…不本意な治療だったのですか？
dialogue.content: I see... That must have been very difficult... Was it a treatment you didn't want?

dialogue.origin: 卵巣の病気で、すみません、子宮は置いといてほしかった
dialogue.content: It was an ovarian disease—sorry, I meant I wish they had left my uterus.

dialogue.origin: の間違いでした
dialogue.content: That was a mistake.

dialogue.origin: 卵巣に病気が見つかり、全摘出
dialogue.content: They found a disease in my ovaries and removed them entirely.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: それは、言葉では言い表せないほど、ショックだったと思います…
dialogue.content: That must have been a shock beyond words...

dialogue.origin: 何かにつけて子供が生める身体だからいいやんって
dialogue.content: Whenever something comes up, I feel like they're thinking, 'Well, at least I have a body that can bear children.'

dialogue.origin: 友達の悩みに素直になれず、
dialogue.content: and I can't be sincere about my friends' problems.

dialogue.origin: はい。悲しいですね……
dialogue.content: Yes. That's very painful...

dialogue.origin: 幸せな人はもっとねたみしか・・
dialogue.content: And for people who are happy, I feel nothing but even more envy...

dialogue.origin: こんな自分に嫌気が。でも喜べない。
dialogue.content: I'm sick of myself for being this way. But I just can't be happy for them.

dialogue.origin: はい…　本当に今まで、たくさんの言葉では決して表現しつくせないような、おつらい思いをして生きていらっしゃったのですね…
dialogue.content: Yes... It sounds like you've lived through so much pain, more than words could ever express...

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: よく、がんばって生きていらっしゃったと思います
dialogue.content: I think you've done so well to keep going.

dialogue.origin: これからも生きていかないといけないのですが
dialogue.content: But I have to keep on living.

dialogue.origin: もし、よろしければ、お伝えしたいことがあるのですが、よろしいですか。
dialogue.content: If it's alright, there's something I'd like to share with you. May I?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 本当に頑張って生きていらっしゃいました。このような思いは、なかなかほかの人に気軽にお話できるようなことではなかったと思います。
dialogue.content: You have truly done so well to live through all this. I imagine these feelings were not something you could easily talk about with other people.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 人の幸せを喜べないのは、喜びたいというあなたの優しいお人柄を感じました。
dialogue.content: The fact that you're pained by not being able to rejoice in others' happiness tells me that you have a kind personality and a desire to do so.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ひどいことがたくさんあったご家族でしたが、それでもつながりを保っていらっしゃる。お父様からもお手紙をいただいていることからも、反発はありながら、ご家族を大切に思い愛していらっしゃってきたことを感じました。
dialogue.content: You had a family where many terrible things happened, but you still maintain a connection. The fact that you received a letter from your father shows me that despite your rebellion, you have cherished and loved your family.

dialogue.origin: つらいお気持ちが、でてきたら、私は、一生けん命生き抜いてきたことをご自身でほめてみたらいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: When these painful feelings come up, how about trying to praise yourself for having survived and lived so earnestly?

dialogue.origin: 喜べない気持ちは、自分でその気持ちがあることを認めてあげる。
dialogue.content: As for the feelings of not being able to rejoice, allow yourself to simply acknowledge that those feelings are there.

dialogue.origin: 褒める？ですか？生めない事をいまでも自分の中で受け止め切れていない。けどやってみます。
dialogue.content: Praise myself? I still haven't been able to fully accept that I can't have children. But I'll try.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい。受け止めきれないお気持ちをもっとお聞きしたいのですが。。
dialogue.content: Yes. I would like to hear more about the feelings you haven't been able to accept...

dialogue.origin: 時間ですね
dialogue.content: Our time is up, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: もっと、具体的にアドバイスをしたいのですが、お時間です。
dialogue.content: I would like to offer more concrete advice, but our time is up.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.content: We'll end the session here, then.

dialogue.origin: はい、お疲れ様でした
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you for your time.

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time.

topic.sub: 自身の性格に対する嫌悪感
